description: Keeneland has added three supplements to its Championship Sale: a 2.5% fractional interest in Upstart; a lifetime breeding right in Life Is Good; and a 50% ownership interest in Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf (G1T) pre-entrant Citrus Springs.

description: Trainer Horacio De Paz will send out five contenders led by Twenty Six Black on Saturday's Empire Showcase Day card at Belmont Park, which offers 10 stakes exclusively for horses foaled in New York State valued at a combined $2.1 million in purses.

title_en: Three-Year-Olds Step Up Against Elders in Cox Plate
description: Two of Australia's most exciting 3-year-olds will attempt to upstage an accomplished older generation when Warwoven and Blind Raise take their places in the Oct. 24 Cox Plate (G1).

title_en: Canadian Breeder Everatt Dies at 86
description: James "Jim" Everatt, who with his wife, Janeane, established Shannondoe Farm and became a prominent Thoroughbred breeder in Canada, died Oct. 15 at his residence in St. Thomas, Ontario. He was 86.

description: AJ Will Win Stables' millionaire Barbadian Runner, a $5,000 yearling, seeks a second consecutive victory in the headline event of the 41st edition of the Jim McKay Maryland Million, the Maryland Million Classic.

title_en: Program Offers Incentive for Ontario Breeders
description: Thanks to new money from the provincial government, the Ontario Thoroughbred Improvement Program's Mare Purchase Program has a total budget of $750,000 for the 2026-27 fall/winter season, up from $400,000 in 2025-26.

title_en: TAA Announces 2026 Organization Accreditations
description: Thoroughbred Aftercare Alliance announces Oct. 22 that 45 Thoroughbred aftercare organizations have been awarded accreditation for 2026.

description: A year after skipping the Breeders' Cup Juvenile (G1), Chad Summers has targeted the World Championships this year with his now Preakness Stakes (G1) winner Napoleon Solo.

title_en: Stellify Interest Among Keeneland November Supplements
description: Keeneland has supplemented a total of five horses to its two November sales with Dothraki Sea, in foal to Flightline, and a 50% fractional interest in grade 3 winner Stellify joining Book 1 of the Keeneland November Breeding Stock Sale Nov. 3.

description: Ocala Stud's 2027 stallion roster is headed by Kantharos, who is returning to the Sunshine State and will stand for $8,500, live foal stands and nurses.

description: With the local community rallying behind it, Eureka Downs has returned to horse racing. Now, that community aims to make it a success.

description: At the end of the third session, 268 horses had changed hands for $15,153,000, including private sales. The gross was down compared to last year's third session, which saw 278 horses sell for $19,747,500.

description: April Mayberry, bidding on behalf of C R K Stable, did not budge when going to $500,000 to secure Hip 1030, a filly from the first crop of 2022 champion 2-year-old male Forte Oct. 21 at the Fasig-Tipton Kentucky October Yearlings Sale.

title_en: Mystik Bayou Joins Derby Trail in Street Sense
description: Mystik Dan's half brother Mystik Bayou follows in the hoofprints of his brother Oct. 25 as he joins the Kentucky Derby (G1) trail in the $200,000 Street Sense Stakes (G3) at Churchill Downs.

description: Rabbah Bloodstock's spending spree at the Arqana October Sale continues Oct. 21 when it lands five more yearlings, including the day's top lot, a filly by Sioux Nation.

description: Andrew Beck and Ben Gowans teamed up as Young Squirrel Stables to secure the full sister to Breeders' Cup Juvenile (G1) contender Gaudreau for $725,000 during Day 3 of the Fasig-Tipton Kentucky October Yearlings Sale.

title_en: No Nay Never, Not This Time Well Represented for BC

description: Silent Tactic will take on older horses Oct. 24 in the $350,000 Fayette Stakes (G3) at Keeneland, and the result could be impact future plans.

description: Trainer Cherie DeVaux adds blinkers to the equipment of C R K Stable's Remember Mamba, the 3-1 morning-line favorite in an overdrawn renewal of the $400,000 Bryan Station Stakes (G2T) Oct. 24 at Keeneland.

description: Almeraq, the highest-rated sprinter in Europe this year, has been retired and will join the roster at Shadwell's Beech House Stud in Newmarket for the 2027 breeding season.

description: In rolling to a five-race win streak in the fall and winter of 2025-26, Sister Troienne displayed talent in top turf races but, surprisingly, a graded stakes victory has eluded her grasp.
